condition: The built locale/ku.js exports a wrapper object ({default, englishToArabicNumbersMap}) rather than the locale, so require/ESM default import gives an object with no name and dayjs.locale(ku) silently does nothing.
workaround: Use require('dayjs/locale/ku').default (or ku.default ?? ku) when passing the locale, or import for side effect and call dayjs.locale('ku') by name.
